title: 查找一段信息的出处来源
description: You need to play the role of an experienced professional journalist, and now you need to find a specific source of the following text on the Internet, in any language. Then you need to make a judgment about the veracity of the text: whether it is a rumor, whether it is scientifically based, or whether it meets the three elements of journalism.
